name: Qwen Cloud
label: Qwen Cloud
description: Official Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope) Qwen APIs on the v2 agent model contract (INPUT llm_input → OUTPUT llm_output). operation selects chat / analyze_image (OpenAI-compat POST /compatible-mode/v1/chat/completions), generate_image (Wan text2image), or generate_video (Wan video-synthesis). Auth is StudioQuack secret api_key sent as Bearer. base_url is the DashScope origin (Singapore intl, Beijing, US Virginia, or a workspace host) — keys are not interchangeable. Docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/compatibility-of-openai-with-dashscope. Terms: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/related-agreements. Never log api_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: llm_input
ports.description: v2 LLM request so this node can sit on the AI Agent model FUNCTION port. Shape: {messages, tools?, stream?, model?, input?, parameters?, file?}. Image/video use type file (platform ref-id). Do not put api_key here.

schema.label: messages
schema.description: Conversation for chat / analyze_image. VL models use image_url / video_url content parts. Image sources use type file. Example: [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}].

schema.label: input
schema.description: DashScope native body for generate_image / generate_video, e.g. {prompt, negative_prompt?} or {prompt, media?}.

schema.label: parameters
schema.description: DashScope native parameters (size, n, resolution, duration, ratio, prompt_extend).

schema.label: task_id
schema.description: Async image/video task id for polling GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id}. Example: abc123.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for VL chat or Wan image/video inputs. Never inline bytes.

schema.label: inputFiles
schema.description: user-uploaded files and voice clips for the model

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind: image, document, audio, or video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png

children.label: source
children.description: How the payload is carried: base64 or url.

children.label: data
children.description: base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url)

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name

schema.label: temperature
schema.description: Request-body parameter `temperature` for operations: chat, analyze_image.

schema.label: top_p
schema.description: Request-body parameter `top_p` for operations: chat, analyze_image.

schema.label: max_tokens
schema.description: Request-body parameter `max_tokens` for operations: chat, analyze_image.

ports.name: llm_output
ports.description: v2 LLM response envelope. Image/video async tasks return a task id — poll GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id} is not a catalog verb. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed DashScope JSON (chat completion or async task).

schema.label: outputFiles
schema.description: files produced by the model, e.g. generated images/audio

children.label: kind
children.description: File kind: image, document, audio, or video.

children.label: mime_type
children.description: RFC 1521 media type, e.g. application/pdf, image/png

children.label: source
children.description: How the payload is carried: base64 or url.

children.label: data
children.description: base64-encoded payload (when source=base64) or absolute URL (when source=url)

children.label: name
children.description: Original filename, surfaced as the upload name

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official DashScope verb. EXACT values: chat | analyze_image | generate_image | generate_video. chat and analyze_image share POST /compatible-mode/v1/chat/completions (VL content for analyze_image).

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: DashScope / Model Studio API key for the origin in base_url. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Keys are region-specific (intl vs PRC vs US). StudioQuack secret binding only. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Base URL
configurationParameters.description: DashScope origin only (HTTPS), no path. Interpolated as api_spec baseUrl. intl default https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com. PRC: https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com. US: https://dashscope-us.aliyuncs.com. Workspace-specific hosts {WorkspaceId}.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com / {WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com are also documented. Pair with an api_key from the same region.

configurationParameters.label: Model
configurationParameters.description: Chat/VL. Default qwen-plus (still listed). Current Model Studio ids: qwen3.8-max, qwen3.7-plus, qwen3.6-plus, qwen3.5-plus, qwen-plus, qwen3.6-flash, qwen-flash, qwen-turbo, qwen3-coder-plus, qwen3-vl-plus / qwen-vl-plus. Image: wan2.5-t2i-preview. Video: wan2.7-i2v / wan2.5-t2v. Match the region's catalog. Docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/models .

configurationParameters.label: Task Id
configurationParameters.description: Async image/video task id for polling GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id}. Example: abc123.

configurationParameters.label: Stream
configurationParameters.description: Purpose: controls whether Qwen Cloud requests a streamed completion and fans live deltas through helper emitPartial. Canonical flag. When true the node POSTs stream:true, parses SSE data: lines, emitPartial("thinking", delta) for reasoning/thinking and emitPartial("answer", delta) for content; thoughts also appear on llm_output.result.thoughts / thinking; finish_reason, usage and tool_calls are assembled at the end. Accepted: select true | false. Default: true. Invalid/blank → true. Example: true.
